defects.title: Unresolved identity leaves a protected case action enabled
reproduction: Serve a ready readiness view with identity.available=[] and configured=false
defects.expected: Protected action is blocked with typed identity refusal and identity repair path
defects.observed: Create case is enabled and no disabled reason is rendered
defects.required_correction: Use resolved identity and standing in every protected-action guard before the action is reachable.

defects.title: Important readiness status resolves only to a citation, not a source record
defects.expected: Status opens a committed typed record/event/digest with freshness, rebuild, and assurance
defects.observed: UI shows a source_ref citation and synthetic readiness_source_citation payload
defects.required_correction: Link status/evidence to authoritative typed records and expose their digest and rebuild state.

defects.title: Denial and approval context lacks typed policy and separation evidence
defects.expected: Reason code, matched policy/boundary, actor/resource/effect, eligibility, expiry, and next action are visible
defects.observed: Guard denial has guard id/text/repair link; approval failure detail is free-form and rows omit eligibility context
defects.required_correction: Render the structured authority and approval records, including separation-of-duty eligibility and lawful next action.

defects.title: No executable governed command or agent journey is available
reproduction: Look for a launch path that produces a run episode
defects.expected: User can execute after authority and inspect progress, termination, evidence, evaluation, settlement, and recovery
defects.observed: Delegation only previews a contract and lists existing records; no actual execution/agent termination/secret/transcript/recovery path is available
defects.required_correction: Provide the governed execution and agent episode journey with separate authority, termination, evidence, evaluation, settlement, and recovery records.

defects.title: Canonical model, capability, artifact, federation, and derived-store surfaces are unbacked
defects.expected: Each in-scope canonical surface has contract-faithful states and governed actions
defects.observed: Routes render UnbackedSurface and report their backing methods absent; journeys cannot be completed
defects.required_correction: Implement source-backed surfaces and transitions or obtain explicit owner exclusions; do not count the route as a completed journey.

defects.title: Live case horizon has no governed lifecycle or recovery controls
reproduction: Open /cases with a case fixture containing active, blocked, parked, retry, and failed work
defects.expected: Transition causes and append-only retry/replan/reopen/terminate/park/resume/recovery paths are available
defects.observed: Horizon is a read-only projection with limited item execution/settlement display
defects.required_correction: Add source-backed transition detail and governed append-only lifecycle/recovery actions.

defects.title: Governed memory recall and disclosure-constrained audit search are absent
reproduction: Look for actor-bound recall and stale-index recovery
defects.expected: Retrieval is constrained before disclosure, falls back to authoritative records, and records influence on work
defects.observed: Memory is an unbacked route; no recall, audit/disclosure search, freshness fallback, or influence link is observable
defects.required_correction: Add constrained recall and audit search backed by authoritative records with freshness/rebuild and influence links.

defects.title: Current-affordance capability control is inert and can be occluded
reproduction: Open /readiness with the default evidence region open
defects.expected: The primary control opens the current capability evidence or route and remains pointer-reachable
defects.observed: The button has no onClick; Playwright click is intercepted by the open evidence region
defects.required_correction: Make the control perform a real evidence/navigation action and prevent the evidence region from intercepting unrelated primary controls.

blockers: Native Tauri/server integration and owner-supplied fixtures were unavailable; evaluation used deterministic mocks.
stop_reason: FAIL_CONTINUE: hard-gate failures, missing canonical journeys, incomplete mocked evidence, and no integrated execution.
